subject: Social Media
title: Ideological Sorting
description: A quick win: understand Ideological Sorting.

hook.text: Researchers let users control their feed. Most chose more extreme content on their own.

buildup.text: Algorithms don't just reflect preferences. They amplify them. A slight lean becomes firm conviction.

discovery.text: Twitter's own study found its algorithm amplifies right-wing political content more than left-wing.

twist.text: The boost isn't intentional. Partisan content drives more engagement, so the algorithm promotes it.

climax.text: Even neutral users drift. The algorithm tests which direction pulls more clicks—then pushes harder.

punchline.text: The algorithm doesn't pick sides. You do.

quiz.question: Why do algorithms tend to amplify partisan content?
